_note: Community and official pages per town. Every URL here was read off the organisation's own website, never constructed from a name pattern: guessing facebook.com/<TownName> risks linking to somebody squatting it. `covers` lists the locality slugs an entry legitimately serves, because one council page serves a whole LGA and duplicating it per suburb would be noise. To extend this, open the organisation's own site and take the URL from its footer.

entries.name: AlburyCity
entries.note: The council's own page. Roadworks and closures, waste collection changes, what is on at the entertainment centre and the library, and consultation notices.

entries.name: Wodonga Council
entries.note: The council's own page. Roadworks, waste and green waste, Junction Place events, and consultation notices.

entries.name: Wagga Wagga City Council
entries.note: The council's own page. Roadworks and river level notices, waste collection, Civic Theatre and library programs, and consultation.

entries.name: Greater Hume Council
entries.note: Covers the villages north and east of Albury. Road and works notices, waste, pool season dates and grant rounds for the smaller towns.

entries.name: Federation Council
entries.note: The council for the Murray river towns west of Albury. Works notices, waste, and what is on across the shire.

entries.name: Junee Shire Council
entries.note: Works and waste notices, the Junee pool and library, and shire events.

entries.name: Junee Community Centre
entries.note: The neighbourhood centre. Programs, groups and the sort of local notice that never reaches a website.

entries.name: Visit Albury Wodonga
entries.note: The regional tourism page for both sides of the border. Events, markets, festivals and seasonal things to do across the corridor.

entries.name: Visit Greater Hume
entries.note: The shire's tourism account. Markets, shows and the village events that do not make the regional lists.

entries.name: The Border Mail
entries.note: The daily paper for Albury Wodonga and the border. Council decisions, court, sport and the closures nobody else reports.

entries.name: The Daily Advertiser
entries.note: The Wagga paper, covering the city and the wider Riverina. Council, court, sport and river levels.
